svg.title: GitHub activity card setup
svg.desc: This placeholder card will be replaced by an automatically generated GitHub activity summary after the repository workflow runs.
svg.text: Activity card will appear after the workflow runs.
Push these changes, then run "Update GitHub Activity Card" from the Actions tab.
Add an optional PROFILE_STATS_TOKEN secret if you want private contributions included.
The old hosted streak card was failing upstream, so this repo now owns the SVG it displays.
